card.title: IPad Air 4 No Backlight

claims.statement: iPad Air 4 no backlight: try a known-good display and press on the LCD FPC (bending its walls in can fix a loose connector).
Pins 11 and 13 on the LCD FPC are the usual suspects; the most common fault is the backlight filter on that line under a shield, which can burn through the board.
If the filter is good, find shorted smoothing caps with 1 V / 1 A injection and remove them; the large PMIC is a last resort and risks floating the CPU.

procedure: Test known-good display; press on FPC.
Cut shield; check/replace backlight filter (jumper burnt traces).
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Replacing the PMIC risks floating the adjacent CPU.
card.caveats: Reference diode values are in an image. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
